module: Node builder of the flowgraph editor (ongoing Lua port of a C++ class from the imgui-node-editor blueprints example). It organizes the drawing of a node in stages (begin, header, content, input, middle, output, end), measures the ImGui groups of each area, draws the header texture and aligns the node width to the 14-pixel grid. Used by basenode:draw; of no interest outside the editor.
usage:
local builder = require('/lua/ge/extensions/flowgraph/builder')()
builder:Begin(node.id)
builder:Header(im.ImVec4(0.2,0.4,0.8,1)) ; im.TextUnformatted('Titre') ; builder:EndHeader()
builder:Input(pin) ; im.Text('in') ; builder:EndInput()
builder:Middle() ; im.Text('milieu')
builder:Output(pin) ; im.Text('out') ; builder:EndOutput()
builder:End(node)
notes: The module returns a function: require(...)(options) creates an instance (the options table, if provided, becomes the object) and calls init().
The state machine self.CurrentStage is 'invalid' outside drawing. SetStage opens/closes the ImGui groups and IDs and measures leftPinSize, centerSize, rightPinSize, HeaderRect, ContentRect, NodeRect.
Bug: createRect().is_empty uses the global variables w and h (nil) instead of res.w/res.h; it always returns false.
C:init pushes styles (NodeBorder, NodeRounding) on ui_flowgraph_editor without popping them in the same function.
drawDebug is true at initialization; basenode:draw then sets it according to the preference flowgraph.debug.viewMode == 'geometry'.
Output width: the padding before the 'output' group rounds the node width to a multiple of 14 px and takes expectedHeaderWidth into account.

init.desc: Initializes the state (stage 'invalid', sizes at 0, header texture art/imgui_node_header_alt.png) and pushes the NodeBorder/NodeRounding styles.

Begin.desc: Begins a node: resets the header, pushes NodePadding, calls BeginNode and moves to the 'begin' stage.

End.desc: Ends the node: moves to the 'end' stage, calls node:customDrawEnd(self) if it exists, EndNode, draws the rounded header texture, the separator line and the debug rectangles, then returns to 'invalid'.

Header.desc: Opens the header area with the given color.

EndHeader.desc: Closes the header and moves to the 'content' stage.

Input.desc: Opens (if needed) the inputs area and begins an input pin.

Output.desc: Opens (if needed) the outputs area and begins an output pin.

BeginPinDynamic.desc: Calls Input or Output according to pin.direction ('in' or 'out').

EndPinDynamic.desc: Calls EndInput or EndOutput according to pin.direction.

Middle.desc: Moves to the 'middle' stage (central area of the node, for drawMiddle).

expectOutPinWidth.desc: Stores the expected width of the output pins, used to align the node to the grid.

setExpectedHeaderSize.desc: Stores the expected width of the header (text + icons).

SetStage.desc: Changes the drawing stage: closes the groups of the old stage while measuring their rectangles, then opens those of the new one. For 'output', adds padding to round to the grid.

returns.desc: false if the stage is already the current one, otherwise true

makeAlignmentPin.desc: Draws a dummy input pin (12 px high dummy) used to align nodes that have no visible input.

pin.desc: alignment pin (its direction is forced to 'in')
